The Peroneus tertius muscle is located in the anterior compartment of the leg, which is situated in front of the tibia and fibula. This muscle helps in eversion and dorsiflexion (flexing the foot upward) of the foot.

The Peroneus longus and Peroneus brevis muscles are innervated by the superficial fibular nerve, while the Peroneus tertius muscle is innervated by the deep fibular nerve.
